annotation.authors_or_issuer: デジタル社会推進会議 モビリティワーキンググループ (Digital Agency, Japan)
key_provisions_or_claims: Introduces a 'transport trading house function' to integrate mobility demand and supply in local areas.
Selects early commercialization regions and concentrates ministry measures for Level 4 autonomous mobility services.
Plans a Transport Safety Board accident investigation body for autonomous vehicles, with legal-framework study.
Develops road-vehicle cooperation, V2X (5.9GHz) and simulation safety evaluation, with road-vehicle technical standards by FY2026.
Supports cost reduction via leasing/rental, shared digital public goods, and a transparent, fair review process for approvals.
annotation.summary_en: Japan's Mobility Roadmap 2025, issued by the Digital Agency's Mobility Working Group, sets policy for commercializing autonomous driving (Level 4) and integrated local mobility services. It proposes a 'transport trading house' function, early commercialization regions, cost reduction, road-vehicle cooperation tech, and an accident investigation body.
annotation.title_clean: モビリティ・ロードマップ 2025 ― 新たなモビリティサービスの事業化に向けた基本的な考え方と施策 ―
annotation.title_en: Mobility Roadmap 2025: Basic Concepts and Measures for Commercializing New Mobility Services
